name: TrainMei Training Planner
description: Personal training planner with a unified Home decision dashboard and User profile workspace.
changes: Unified Home, Daily Briefing, Training Insights and Training Brain into one dashboard using the existing TrainingDataCore.
Retained Daily Briefing visual summaries and Training Insights weekly, progression, muscle-group and pattern views inside Home.
Removed standalone Daily Briefing and Insights navigation entries on desktop and mobile.
Added User workspace for body metrics, weight history and exercise Weight % progression.
Combined Nutri Tracker and Meal Planner in one workspace with distinct sections; planned meals remain proposals and are never added to real intake automatically.
Removed redundant permanent explanatory copy and consolidated responsive layout rules.
Moved User navigation beside Settings, immediately before Settings.
Simplified Home to Today and the monthly heatmap side-by-side, followed directly by Today at a glance; hid This week, Fuel for today and Next up cards.
Merged the pre-workout Nutrition Optimizer into Nutri Tracker as a Meal Planner tab beside My craving; removed the separate Nutrition Optimizer launcher and route.
Compressed the calorie calculator into a single compact visual panel and tightened the User personal metrics layout on desktop and landscape.
Left OCR, FatSecret and other non-nutrition integrations intact.
